payload.title: Visualizing the Climate Response to Explosive Volcanism
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates how to visualize the climate response to explosive volcanism using various plotting techniques. It focuses on creating visualizations such as Hovmuller diagrams and timeseries plots to analyze stratospheric aerosol optical depth (SAOD) and its impact on climate variables like surface temperature and precipitation. The notebook also guides users in building an interactive dashboard with widgets to explore data from volcanic events over the Common Era.
